description: This file defines a custom NSView subclass, HoverChromeContainerView, which serves as a container with overlay components such as draggable and resizable handles, and a close button. It manages mouse tracking to animate the visibility of a Chrome overlay. Internal classes handle specific UI elements and interactions, including mouse events for dragging and resizing the window.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView
classes.description: Main container view that overlays content and a chrome, manages tracking, and contains inner classes for drag and resize handles, and a chrome overlay.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView.CanvasDragHandleView
classes.description: A subclass of NSView that enables dragging the window by responding to mouse down events.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView.CanvasResizeHandleView
classes.description: A subclass of NSView that allows resizing the window via mouse dragging, tracking initial position and window frame.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView.CanvasChromeOverlayView
classes.description: An overlay view with buttons and handles for closing, dragging, and resizing, with custom hit-testing behavior to allow mouse events to pass through or be intercepted.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView.PassthroughVisualEffectView
classes.description: A subclass of NSVisualEffectView that overrides hitTest to always return nil, making it pass-through for mouse events.

methods.name: updateTrackingAreas
methods.description: Overrides to update mouse tracking areas when the view's bounds change, adding a new tracking area and removing the old one.

methods.name: acceptsFirstMouse(for:)
methods.description: Enables views to accept mouse events even if they are not the first responder.

methods.name: mouseDown(with:)
methods.description: Handles mouse down events to initiate drag or resize operations.

methods.name: mouseDragged(with:)
methods.description: Handles mouse dragged events for resizing the window.

methods.name: hitTest(_:)
methods.description: Custom hit-testing to determine which subview should receive mouse events, allowing pass-through for certain overlays.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Triggered when the close button is pressed; executes the onClose callback.
